entry.title: Awesome Steam Updates on May 23 - May 29, 2016
entry.content:
Node.js / General

  • steam (⭐1k) - Interface directly with Steam servers from Node.js.
  • steam-client (⭐55) - API-compatible fork of node-steam's SteamClient.
  • steam-user (⭐1.1k) - Feature-rich easy-to-use Steam client.
  • vapor (⭐111) - Lightweight Steam client framework.
  • steam-parentbot (⭐33) - Simple base class for a Steam bot.

Node.js / Trading

  • steam-trade (⭐162) - Node.js wrapper around Steam live trading.
  • steam-tradeoffers (⭐291) - Steam Trade Offers for Node.js.
  • steam-tradeoffer-manager (⭐595) - Simple and sane Steam trade offer management.

Node.js / Game Interaction

  • tf2 (⭐62) - Interact directly with TF2 game coordinator.
  • csgo (⭐468) - Interact directly with CS:GO game coordinator.
  • dota2 (⭐553) - Interact directly with Dota 2 game coordinator.

Node.js / Community & Store Automation

  • steamcommunity (⭐548) - Interact with steamcommunity.com. Also allows to confirm trade offers.
  • steamstore (⭐70) - Interact with store.steampowered.com.
  • steam-weblogon (⭐28) - Retrieve SteamCommunity cookies if you are running Steam network client.
  • steam-web-api-key (⭐21) - Automatically registers and retrieves Steam API key.
  • steam-parental (⭐4) - Disable parental lock.

Node.js / Authentication

  • passport-steam (⭐358) - Steam (OpenID) authentication strategy for Passport and Node.js.
  • meteor-accounts-steam (⭐17) - Steam OpenID integration for Meteor Accounts.

Node.js / Misc

  • steam-resources (⭐24) - Steam's enums, protobufs and structs.
  • steam-crypto (⭐15) - Node.js implementation of Steam crypto.
  • steam-groups (⭐15) - Custom node-steam handler which provides group functions.
  • steamid (⭐71) - SteamID usage and conversion made easy.
  • steam-totp (⭐256) - Easily generate 2FA codes used by Steam.
  • steam-chat-bot (⭐106) - Simplified interface for a steam chat bot.
  • vdf (⭐21) - vdf to object and vice versa.
  • steamrep (⭐10) - Check user's SteamRep reputation.
  • reptf (⭐2) - Check user's rep.tf reputation.

PHP / Misc

  • SteamCommunity (⭐79) - A PHP library for interacting with the Steam Community website.
  • SteamAuthentication (⭐445) - Steam OpenID authentication with PHP.
  • SteamAuthOOP (⭐40) - An object-oriented alternative to SteamAuthentication.

Go / Misc

  • steam-mobileauth (⭐19) - Port of SteamAuth in Go.

Python / General

  • steam (⭐1.3k) - Module for various interactions with Steam.
  • steamodd (⭐80) - Steam tools library.

C++ / Misc

  • SteamPP (⭐117) - C++ library to interoperate with Steam servers.

Java / Misc

  • SteamKit-Java (⭐50) - Java port of SteamKit.

Objective-C / Misc

  • SteamAuth (⭐6) - An iOS wrapper around Steam's OpenID login.

General / Misc

  • Steam WebAPI @ ValveSoftware
  • Steam WebAPI @ TF2 Wiki
  • Steam Error Codes - List of EResult codes with possible explanations.

Tutorials / Misc

  • Creating a Steam Trade Bot with Node.js

Standalone Tools / Misc

  • NetHook2 (⭐3k) - Intercept Steam client's network messages.
  • NetHook2 Analyzer (⭐3k) - Inspect messages dumped by NetHook2.
  • steam-auth-web-util - Generate 2FA codes directly in your web browser.
  • SteamDesktopAuthenticator (⭐3.7k) - Desktop implementation of Steam's mobile authenticator app.

Discussion Boards / Misc

  • /r/SteamBot
  • /r/SteamBot Discord
  • /r/nodesteam
  • DoctorMcKay's Dev Forum
  • node-steam-forum (⭐43)
